en.title: Sympathy in Egypt for Sameh Hussein Following Health Crisis
en.summary: Egyptian actor Sameh Hussein received widespread sympathy after being admitted to intensive care due to a sudden health emergency.

en.summary: One person was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Taif.

stories.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif

en.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif
en.summary: A Yemeni resident was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Saudi Arabia's Taif, also causing material damage to buildings and vehicles.

stories.title: Houthi drone debris kills Yemeni resident in Saudi Arabia’s Taif

en.title: Houthi drone debris kills Yemeni resident in Saudi Arabia's Taif
en.summary: A Yemeni resident died and two others were injured from debris of an intercepted Houthi drone in Taif, with one Pakistani national in critical condition and damage to property.

stories.title: Jordan, France sign defense cooperation deal as King Abdullah meets Macron

en.title: Jordan, France sign defense cooperation deal as King Abdullah meets Macron
en.summary: Jordan's King Abdullah II and French President Emmanuel Macron held talks in Paris, during which the two countries signed a defense cooperation agreement. The king emphasized the importance of Jordan-France partnership and praised France's support for Lebanese Armed Forces.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Smithsonian partner to protect endangered Arabian leopard

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Smithsonian partner to protect endangered Arabian leopard
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Royal Commission for AlUla and the Smithsonian's National Zoo have opened a new habitat for the endangered Arabian leopard in Washington, D.C. The partnership aims to advance conservation efforts for a species with fewer than 120 individuals remaining in the wild.

stories.title: Kids and social media: what would change under new EU law

en.title: Kids and social media: what would change under new EU law
en.summary: The European Union has proposed legal measures to restrict children's access to social media and digital platforms, including age limits and removal of addictive features to protect minors.

stories.title: EU Commission Proposes Under-13s Social Media Ban

en.title: EU Commission Proposes Under-13s Social Media Ban
en.summary: The EU Commission has proposed a ban on social media access for children under 13 years old.

stories.title: Royal Commission for AlUla, Smithsonian’s National Zoo break ground on Arabian leopard habitat in Washington

en.title: Royal Commission for AlUla, Smithsonian's National Zoo break ground on Arabian leopard habitat in Washington
en.summary: The Royal Commission for AlUla and Smithsonian's National Zoo broke ground on a dedicated Arabian leopard habitat in Washington to protect the critically endangered species. A breeding pair from Saudi Arabia's conservation program is expected to relocate to the U.S. zoo pending regulatory approvals.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince receives message from King Abdullah of Jordan

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince receives message from King Abdullah of Jordan
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received a written message from Jordan's King Abdullah regarding bilateral relations between the two nations.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a Houthi drone attack on Makkah and stated it reserves the right to take necessary defensive measures to protect the Two Holy Mosques and their pilgrims.

en.title: Saudi Printing shareholders to vote on 89.4% capital cut on Oct. 26
en.summary: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co. will hold a shareholder vote to reduce its capital from SAR 652.07 million to SAR 68.97 million, eliminating SAR 583.10 million in accumulated losses through the restructuring.

stories.title: ‎Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe

en.title: Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe
en.summary: Lucid Group and Bolt announced a partnership to develop and deploy autonomous vehicles across Europe, with Bolt planning to operate at least 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles by 2035.

en.title: Arab Sea appoints Al-Hawas as Chairman
en.summary: Arab Sea Information Systems Co. appointed Abdullah Al-Hawas as Chairman and Haitham Al-Suhaibani as Vice Chairman for a three-year term through September 2029.

en.summary: Asas Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Co. signed a SAR 315 million contract with Itihad Al-Thabat Contracting for construction and finishing work on residential and commercial projects in Riyadh spanning 65,000 square meters.

stories.title: ‎Avalon Pharma renews SAR 104M credit facilities with BSF

en.title: Avalon Pharma renews SAR 104M credit facilities with BSF
en.summary: Avalon Pharma has renewed Shariah-compliant credit facilities worth SAR 104 million with Banque Saudi Fransi for one year. The facilities, guaranteed by promissory notes, will support the company's working capital needs.
